headlines.description: Crystal Palace boss Pierre Sage suffered a frustrating Europa League defeat after his side fell 3-2 to his former employers Lyon at the Groupama Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crystal Palace boss Sage beaten on return to Lyon

headlines.description: Alphadjo Cissè scored a hat trick as AC Milan got their Europa League campaign up and running with a 4-0 win at RB Salzburg, who slipped to a first defeat of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cissè hat trick leads Milan to rout of Salzburg

headlines.description: Noah Sadiki scored a last-gasp winner for Sunderland in the Europa League as they came from behind to beat Torreense 2-1 in Leiria.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sunderland fight back to beat 2nd-tier Torreense

headlines.description: Bournemouth won their first European match at the Vitality Stadium as Sturm Graz were beaten 3-0 to maintain Marco Rose's perfect start in the Europa League.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bournemouth enjoy dream European home debut
